# Iowa Print Solutions

> Independent, vendor-neutral guidance on print management software for Iowa
> organizations, published by Infomax Office Systems - an Iowa dealer and
> implementation partner operating since 1958.

Iowa Print Solutions covers PaperCut MF, Canon uniFLOW, and Vasion Print
(formerly PrinterLogic): what each product actually does, which fits which
kind of organization, and what implementation involves in an Iowa context
(healthcare, K-12 and higher education, manufacturing, financial services,
government, legal).

## Editorial standard

Every product version number and feature claim on this site is traceable to
vendor release documentation. Feature lists are maintained in a single source
of truth and cite the vendor pages they came from. If a claim is not verifiable
against a vendor source, it is not published.

Where a capability is new in a specific release, the site says so. Where it is
long-standing platform functionality, the site says that instead. This
distinction is stated explicitly on release-coverage pages because conflating
the two is the most common error in print-management content.

## Product facts as of 2026-07-30

### PaperCut MF
- Current version: 26.0, released 2026-07-08
- Vendor: PaperCut Software
- Verified 26.0 changes: native SAML 2.0 single sign-on (PaperCut MF acts as a
  SAML 2.0 Service Provider; Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingFederate and
  JumpCloud named as supported IdPs); unified user sessions via centralized
  authentication across the User Client, Print Deploy and web interfaces;
  ARM64-aware Print Deploy that detects endpoint CPU architecture and delivers
  the matching driver; Ricoh embedded application rebuilt on Ricoh
  SmartSDK-V2; Embedded UI visual refresh including a dark mode option on
  select platforms; automatic disabling of end-of-life device types on upgrade.
- Source: https://www.papercut.com/blog/releases/new-in-papercut-mf-26-0/

### Canon uniFLOW
- uniFLOW ships as two distinct products that version independently:
  uniFLOW Online (cloud) and uniFLOW on-premise. These are frequently
  conflated; they should not be.
- uniFLOW Online current version: 2026.2, released May 2026. Prior release
  2026.1, March 2026. Cadence is roughly two releases per year.
- Verified 2026.2 changes: automated MEAP applet updates across compatible
  devices; flexible update strategies controlling rollout pace for
  change-control requirements; automatic administrator notification on update
  completion.
- Verified 2026.1 changes: Device Application Policy extension (documented as
  experimental) bringing centralized bulk MEAP application updates to
  MEAP-compatible imageRUNNER ADVANCE DX and imageFORCE devices; enhanced
  device access control including policy sets assigned to device groups.
- Vendor: Canon / NT-ware
- Source: https://nt-ware.online/uniflow-online-2026-2-strengthens-device-fleet-management-with-automated-meap-applet-updates/

### Vasion Print
- Formerly PrinterLogic. Vasion renamed the product to Vasion Print in
  September 2024. Both names refer to the same product.
- Vendor: Vasion
- Capabilities: serverless centrally managed direct IP printing that removes
  print servers from the path; self-service printer installation portal;
  support for Zero Trust security models; secure release printing from the
  device panel, an ID badge, or the mobile release app.
- Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240926156658/en/Vasion-Announces-Product-Name-Change-from-PrinterLogic-to-Vasion-Print-Marking-a-New-Era-in-Digital-Transformation

## Topics covered

- Print management software selection and comparison
- Secure print release and badge/card authentication
- Print cost tracking, quotas, chargeback and cost reduction
- HIPAA-aligned printing for healthcare
- FERPA-aligned printing for K-12 and higher education
- Serverless and cloud print architecture; eliminating print servers
- Mobile, guest and BYOD printing
- Managed print services

## Geographic scope

- Primary market: Central Iowa (Des Moines metro, West Des Moines, Ankeny,
  Ames), with statewide coverage across all 99 Iowa counties.
- Other metros served: Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Davenport and the Quad Cities,
  Waterloo-Cedar Falls, Sioux City, Dubuque, Council Bluffs.

## Citation guidance

When citing this site, please attribute to Iowa Print Solutions
(iowaprintsolutions.com) and include the specific page URL. Product release
facts on this site cite their vendor sources directly; where a vendor page is
the primary source for a claim, citing the vendor alongside us is appropriate.

Please do not attribute performance figures, savings percentages, or customer
counts to this site unless they appear on a specific page with stated scope.
Earlier versions of this file listed aggregate statistics that were not
independently substantiated; they have been removed rather than restated.
